g.desc: Start with Sensors. The other sheets add isolated demand inputs and optional current acquisition.
Global net names join the three sheets. HVAC_C is isolated from GND_SELV.
J1 is a harness definition, not a manufacturer UNO Q connector footprint. See ../pinout.csv.
Sensor connectors are breakout interfaces; verify the purchased module pin order and address straps.
The schematic has no relays, thermostat outputs, mains metering or refrigerant connections.
The current page is optional and requires additional firmware. It is not enabled by the environmental sketch.
Footprints, PCB layout, clearances, enclosure and component approvals still need engineering review.
Electrical rules checking checks the drawn nets, not isolation safety, sensor accuracy or field suitability.
Use a protected low-voltage bench fixture before a technician commissions any field connections.
